study.comparator: reduced calorie diet and exercise counselling alone (open label)
study.notes: STUDY: single centre randomised open label controlled trial (AIG Hospitals, Hyderabad, June 2022 to December 2023, NCT05442450) in adults with BMI 30 or more, or 27 or more with a weight related comorbidity, without diabetes: oral semaglutide 3 mg escalated to 7 and 14 mg daily (dose_mg 14) plus diet and exercise vs diet and exercise alone, 28 weeks; 116 randomised in blocks of 6 by an independent observer, 58 per arm, all completed (100 percent retention); Table 3 (Springer table page, companion capture katrevula2025_oral_semaglutide_aig_tables1_3.txt) gives estimated mean (SE) changes per arm and the estimated treatment difference with 95 percent CI at week 28 (route ci_95), Table 1 gives baselines (companion capture); the Table 3 unit labels for fasting glucose (mmol/L), fasting insulin (percent) and hsCRP (percent) are inconsistent with the Table 1 units (mg/dL, uIU/mL, mg/L) and magnitudes, so those three rows carry no baseline denominators and are flagged; the liver enzyme and elastography rows of Table 3 print reductions with a positive sign while the text reports decreases, so ALT is entered from the text per arm pre and post means with SD (route arm_change_imputed_r) and AST is not entered; secondary endpoints named in the protocol (prespecified TRUE); pct_weight_change is the Table 3 ETD in percent weight change, minus 8.06 (95 percent CI minus 9.85 to minus 6.27; arms minus 10.47 vs minus 2.41); no specific funding (industry_funded FALSE); rob_overall some_concerns

rows.notes: Table 3: change in HbA1c percent at week 28, ETD minus 0.37 (minus 0.49 to minus 0.25), arms minus 0.46 (SE 0.05) vs minus 0.09 (SE 0.03); Table 1 baseline 5.8 and 5.8

Table 3: change in fasting plasma glucose at week 28 labelled mmol/L, ETD minus 5.52 (minus 8.15 to minus 2.88), arms minus 5.83 (SE 1.16) vs minus 0.31 (SE 0.68); Table 1 baseline 96.5 and 95.8 mg/dL, so the printed unit is doubtful and no denominator is entered

Table 3: change in fasting serum insulin at week 28 labelled percent, ETD minus 6.67 (minus 9.89 to minus 3.45), arms minus 6.96 (SE 1.6) vs minus 0.28 (SE 0.39); Table 1 baseline 23.7 and 20.6 uIU/mL, unit doubtful, no denominator entered
Table 3: change in systolic BP mmHg at week 28, ETD minus 3.62 (minus 6.12 to minus 1.12), arms minus 5.31 (SE 0.85) vs minus 1.69 (SE 0.95); Table 1 baseline 128 and 133
Table 3: change in diastolic BP mmHg at week 28, ETD minus 5.34 (minus 7.95 to minus 2.74), arms minus 5.83 (SE 0.86) vs minus 0.48 (SE 1.02); Table 1 baseline 87 and 87
Table 3: change in total cholesterol mg/dL at week 28, ETD minus 9.38 (minus 15.24 to minus 3.52), arms minus 6.74 (SE 2.52) vs 2.64 (SE 1.61); Table 1 baseline 186.8 and 190.8
Table 3: change in LDL cholesterol mg/dL at week 28, ETD minus 4.32 (minus 8.93 to 0.28), arms minus 2.4 (SE 2.07) vs 1.93 (SE 1.11); Table 1 baseline 115.4 and 115.5
Table 3: change in triglycerides mg/dL at week 28, ETD minus 31.07 (minus 49.31 to minus 12.83), arms minus 25.29 (SE 8.93) vs 5.78 (SE 2.63); Table 1 baseline 142.2 and 158.6

Table 3: change in hsCRP at week 28 labelled percent, ETD minus 3.41 (minus 4.96 to minus 1.87), arms minus 3.44 (SE 0.69) vs minus 0.03 (SE 0.37); Table 1 baseline 7.2 and 6.5 mg/L, so a percent label is implausible and mg/L is likely; unit doubtful, no denominator entered, row not convertible until a verifier settles the unit

Results text: ALT (SGPT) U/L per arm, semaglutide 54.23 (plus or minus 44.12) to 28.81 (plus or minus 12.51), control 36.97 (plus or minus 20.78) to 38.83 (plus or minus 16.44); Table 3 prints the SGPT change with a positive sign (25.31 vs minus 1.86, ETD 27.18), contradicting the text, so the text values are used

json.design: single centre randomised open label controlled trial, oral semaglutide 14 mg plus lifestyle vs lifestyle alone, adults with overweight or obesity without diabetes, 116 randomised (58 per arm), 28 weeks
json.reason: full text group (institutional route) with Tables 1 and 3 read from the Springer table pages through the proxy; ten inventory markers, seven convertible (HbA1c, SBP, DBP, TC, LDL, TG by ci_95 with Table 1 denominators; ALT by the imputed route from the text), three entered without denominators because the printed units are inconsistent (fasting glucose, fasting insulin, hsCRP)
biomarkers_reported_no_variance: AST (Table 3 SGOT change 19.41 (SE 7.64) vs minus 1.26 (SE 0.62), ETD 20.67, printed with a positive sign while the text reports decreases; not entered)
other_markers: body composition and lean mass (Tables 4 and 5)

rob.justification: computer generated block randomisation by an independent observer (D1 low); open label with a lifestyle only comparator (D2 some concerns); 100 percent retention (D3 low); laboratory assays, blood pressure without blinding (D4 some concerns); registered trial but Table 3 prints inconsistent units and signs (D5 some concerns)

doubts: Table 3 unit labels for fasting glucose, fasting insulin and hsCRP contradict Table 1; the three rows are entered as printed without denominators and need a verifier decision (the hsCRP contrast is most likely minus 3.41 mg/L, about half the baseline)
the liver enzyme and elastography changes in Table 3 carry a positive sign for reductions
the primary report of the registered trial (United European Gastroenterol J, 10.1002/ueg2.12613) is a second identifier of this group and may carry the same data
